answer: Willow delay assigns new identities a 30-day cooldown before full access, enforced by on-chain timelocks tied to initial activity signatures. Each identity must post regular ivory commitments—small, verifiable tasks—else their cooldown resets, costing attackers repeated delays and lost throughput. Karst pathways route early activity through low-trust channels with proportional reward penalties, making mass creation economically painful through diluted returns.
